title: Decorative · callout band (accent-tinted closing strip)
description: Soft accent-tinted closing band — mono eyebrow + one paragraph at 1.0625rem capped at 76ch reading width. Sits at the bottom of SMB / scale / 'where this leads' sections to summarize the takeaway. Subtle outer accent glow + 1 px accent-tinted border. Light theme.

source.decision: PM lock 2026-05-24 — callout-band pattern adopted as standalone decorative block; paired with StagesList / AxesGrid

params.default: One platform · Four stages · No migration required

ServiceWand grows with the operation. Start with a single crew and a calendar; finish with multi-region dispatch, integrated billing, recurring contracts, and AI-assisted workflows — without changing tools or losing data along the way.

notes: Drop at the end of a Section, after content like StagesList or AxesGrid. The accent glow visually 'closes' the section without needing a heavy CTA.
Body uses --color-heading (not --color-text) for slightly bolder contrast — the callout is meant to be read as a statement, not a body paragraph.
76ch cap keeps the line length comfortable even if the section spans full container width.
